title: Stage 1 Genome Solvability & Multi-objective Signal Feasibility
design: 3 tasks x 3 genomes x 2 seeds = 18 episodes

GATE1_SOLVABILITY.PASS: at least 1 episode with native won=true among the 18

GATE2_GENOME_DISTINGUISHABILITY.PASS_DESCRIPTIVE: at least two paired (task_index, seed) blocks show differing won outcomes across genomes (pre-registered descriptive screen; NOT a KS p-value criterion)
GATE2_GENOME_DISTINGUISHABILITY.COST_ONLY: if won identical across genomes and only cost/length differ: call it cost distinguishability, NOT performance improvement

GATE3_MULTIOBJECTIVE_SIGNAL.PASS: >=1 real success AND >=2 non-dominated (performance, cost) genome-level aggregates with meaningful tradeoff
GATE3_MULTIOBJECTIVE_SIGNAL.rule: cheaper failure is NOT better performance

prohibitions: no silent auto-retry of failed episodes
